description: Packed snow with two dark eyes, heavier than snow should be. Every spike it throws is grown out of itself.
lore: Down in the grass the ground wanders; high under the crystal country nothing has needed correcting in a very long time, and there is hardly anyone left up there to walk on it. Out of ground held that hard comes the high snow's ling: snow pressed into a shape with two dark eyes, far heavier than snow has any business being, and armed entirely out of itself. A spike grows up through its crown and flies, and there is measurably less creature afterwards. It will do that until it cannot.

[[characters/a6d7323d|Gunnar]] goes up each year to check his measurements of the Drift against the one country that never moves, and each year the same one — the eyes set a little crooked; you learn one the way you learn a face — meets him at the last ridge and throws everything it has. He stands out of range and lets it finish. His is the only footfall on that road all year. Whatever it is armed against, he is the whole of what ever arrives.

It is smaller each year. He measures it — he measures everything — and keeps the number where he keeps the rest, to himself. They do not shatter at the end; they slump, into slush inside their own footprint, and the wet mark outlasts them by an hour. Gunnar says that the year it does not throw at him, he will retire the route. He says it the way he says most things, so that you cannot tell whether it is a joke.
